module: Thin wrapper around LuaJIT's string.buffer to read and write JSON/SJSON (https://github.com/Autodesk/sjson). `json.decode` reads text or a buffer; `json.encode` is directly buffer.jsonencode. The old pure-Lua SJSON parser was moved to ljson.lua.
usage:
local t = json.decode('{"a": 1, "b": [1,2,3]}')
local s = json.encode(t)
notes: decode(nil) returns nil. The code avoids buffer.jsondecode directly because it would raise an error if the buffer is not entirely consumed; it uses a shared module buffer (_buf), so decode is not reentrant (not a problem outside coroutines).
M.encode is LuaJIT's buffer.jsonencode: automatic extraction flags it as a field of unknown type; it is indeed a function.

encode.desc: string.buffer.jsonencode: serializes a Lua value (table, number, string, boolean) to JSON text.

decode.desc: Decodes JSON/SJSON. Accepts a string or a string.buffer object (which must have a jsondecode method). Returns nil if the argument is nil.

returns.desc: decoded Lua value (table, number, string, boolean...); error raised if the JSON is invalid (string.buffer behavior)
